title: kicad_specgen_project
description: SpecGen project file. JSON format. Token references only — no absolute paths.

mode.description: repo: project is in a Git-managed workspace. standalone: independent folder.

project.description: Project identity and metadata. All fields available as Jinja2 template variables.

name.description: Short project identifier, used in output filenames

display_name.description: Full human-readable project name for display and report cover

company.description: Company or client name for this project

release_name.description: Release label e.g. Production Release v1.0

files.description: Tokenized project support file references. All values must use {TOKEN_NAME}/... notation. Note: active jobset reference is in jobset.active_jobset, not here.

logo.description: Token reference to logo image file

report_css.description: Token reference to report CSS stylesheet

bom_css.description: Token reference to BOM CSS stylesheet

title_page.description: Token reference to title page Markdown template

end_page.description: Token reference to end page Markdown template

variables.description: Custom user/project variables available as Jinja2 template tokens

custom.description: Key-value pairs. Keys must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$. Values are strings.

jobset.description: Jobset state. SpecGen overrides stored here, never written back to .kicad_jobset.

active_jobset.description: Token reference to the active .kicad_jobset file. Single authoritative jobset reference.

stop_on_error.description: Halt run on first destination failure

clear_log_before_run.description: Clear the Output Log subtab before each run

destinations.description: Per-destination-ID SpecGen overrides, keyed by destination ID from .kicad_jobset

last_run.description: Result of the most recent jobset run. Written by SpecGen after each run.

report.description: Report recipe and output settings. See SpecGen_Tab_Report.md for full behavior.

output_dir.description: Token reference to report output folder. Default: {JOBSET_OUTPUT_DIR}/report/

filename_template.description: Filename template for the output PDF. Supports project metadata tokens.

template.description: Token reference to cover page Markdown template

title.description: Cover page title. May use Jinja2 {{ variable }} syntax.

subtitle.description: Cover page subtitle. May use Jinja2 {{ variable }} syntax.

logo.description: Token reference to logo image for cover page

order.description: Ordered list of page/section identifiers for report assembly

definitions.description: Per-page configuration keyed by page identifier

source_type.description: jobset: from JOBSET_OUTPUT_DIR; markdown: Jinja2 template; custom_pdf: fixed PDF file

section_label.description: Section heading shown in report for this page

fabrication.description: Fabrication ZIP package settings. See SpecGen_Tab_Report.md Fabrication subtab.

output_dir.description: Token reference to FAB ZIP output folder. Default: {JOBSET_OUTPUT_DIR}/fab/

zip_filename_template.description: Filename template for the fabrication ZIP. Supports project metadata tokens.

destinations.description: Per-destination ZIP configuration keyed by destination ID from .kicad_jobset

include.description: Whether to include this destination in the FAB ZIP

zip_folder.description: Folder path within the ZIP. Ex: gerbers/

readme.description: README file included in the FAB ZIP

template.description: Token reference to Jinja2 README Markdown template

checksums.description: Checksum file included in the FAB ZIP

ui.description: Optional project UI state (active tab, panel sizes). Does not set dirty flag. Not committed.
